args.body:
Hello panel,

Below are the finalized offer terms for your review. I’ve omitted candidate personal contact details (HR has those on file).

1) Amelia Reed
- Title: Senior Product Manager
- Proposed base salary: $120,000
- Start date: Flexible (candidate indicated flexibility)
- Relocation assistance: Approved
- Notes: Candidate accepts relocation package; no visa required.

2) Marcus Lin
- Title: Software Engineer II
- Proposed base salary: $115,000
- Start date: Targeting 4–6 weeks after sign-off
- Contingency: Requires hiring manager sign-off before sending formal offer
- Notes: Competitive candidate; recommend expedited sign-off.

3) Sofia Patel
- Title: Data Analyst
- Proposed base salary: $110,000
- Start date: Dependent on visa processing timeline
- Visa sponsorship: Required (company to sponsor)
- Notes: HR to coordinate visa sponsorship timeline and paperwork.

Please review and reply with any changes or approval. Once the panel approves, HR can proceed with formal offer letters and outreach to candidates.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
me@company.com
